descriptionChirho: The masculine noun אֵמֶר meaning 'word, speech, utterance, saying', a poetic synonym of דָּבָר found primarily in Wisdom literature (Job, Psalms, Proverbs). Both clusters share identical semantic content with no discernible difference in meaning: S83172 (4x) and S83173 (2x) both translate uniformly as 'word/speech' across all target languages: eng 'speech/word', spa 'palabra', hin 'वचन/बात', arb 'كَلِمَةً/قَوْلٌ', kor '말씀/말', swa 'maneno/neno/jambo'. The slight variation in Arabic (كَلِمَةً vs قَوْلٌ) and Swahili (maneno vs jambo) reflects contextual translation choices, not distinct senses. These are the same lexicographic meaning.
